text: Isk still feels okay. Hush is underrated.
Earthbreaker cone is hard to aim but feels good when it lands.
Marrow is in a good spot. Strong if your team peels for you.
Tollan is fine but my team never stays near me so the shield does not do much.
Nyra escapes every fight now. Shadowstep is up constantly.
Glad they fixed Ember Lance. It was so annoying when it went through people.
Nyra is fine. Good players can punish her with crowd control.
Nyra feels smoother to play this patch. Getting out after a dive is easier.
Ashfield is fun for holding objectives.
Isk is completely broken right now, her healing is way too strong.
I keep getting caught as Marrow. Tumble cooldown feels long.
